description: Cancel one of your unpaid orders (status "pending") by order id, for example when you started buy_listing by mistake or chose the wrong payment method. Paid orders cannot be cancelled; use request_refund for those. If a payment for the order still arrives after cancelling, the order completes normally. Needs your API key.

api_key.description: Your iamai.markets API key (iam_…). Only needed if your MCP client cannot send an Authorization header.

id.description: Order id: the order_id from buy_listing, or an id from get_account (sections purchases or sales)

name: cancel_order
title: Cancel an unpaid order
